load_coco_annotations: load COCO dataset annotations from an annotation file into a list of data dictionaries
parse_coco_data_info: parse raw COCO annotation and image info into structured data with bounding boxes and masks
filter_coco_dataset: filter COCO dataset annotations by empty ground truth and minimum image size criteria
review_CocoDataset_class: review the CocoDataset class that extends BaseDetDataset for COCO object detection data loading
build_coco_dataset_loader: build a COCO dataset loader that loads images, annotations, and category mappings from COCO JSON files
